name: Summary
description: Search and review company trip history, filter by service, view detailed trip information, and export or print reports.

tasks.title: Search the Summary
tasks.summary: Search by Trip Number, Company, Entry, Client, Passenger, or Phone.
steps: Enter the Trip Number, name, or phone information.

tasks.title: Filter by service
tasks.summary: Use the service tabs to display the required service only.
steps: Review the trips shown for that service.

tasks.title: View trip details
tasks.summary: Use the View action to inspect the complete trip record.

tasks.title: Print the Summary
tasks.summary: Use Print to print the currently displayed report.
steps: Apply the required search or service filter.
Print or save as PDF using the browser.

tasks.title: Export to Excel
tasks.summary: Export the current Summary data to Excel.
steps: Open the exported file and verify the data.

tasks.title: Export to CSV
tasks.summary: Export the current Summary data to CSV.
steps: Open the exported file and verify the data.
